exposure: Physiological pregnancy (full-term and preterm birth after caesarean section at 26-31 weeks)
outcome: Expression levels of microRNA-146a and microRNA-155 in placental villi
cohort: 18 women with early- or late-onset preeclampsia and a reference group of women with physiological pregnancies (full-term and preterm birth after caesarean section at 26-31 weeks)
finding: The expression of microRNA-146a and microRNA-155 was altered in placental villi of women with both early- and late-onset preeclampsia compared to physiological pregnancies, suggesting potential common pathogenetic pathways in different preeclampsia subtypes.
who: Mothers and potentially newborns (through the impact on placental function)
